messages:
emma_cs: Quick triage - BlueRidge onboarding stuck in staging. Their frontend shows 401s on init, then a few 429s after rapid retries. They just adopted browser SDK v1.2.5 and ephemeral tokens.

ryan_eng: @emma_cs can you share the exact client console errors and which scopes they requested?

emma_cs: customer paste: `401 Unauthorized - scope_mismatch` then later `429 Too Many Requests`. Region: us-east-2. Token scope requested: `inference:chat`.

olivia_se: first thought: the client might be hitting an embeddings endpoint (vendor probe) or our SDK telemetry. Have them grep for `/v1/embeddings` in their bundle.

ryan_eng: also ask for the token introspection id. @tim_ops any quick look at edge logs for that timeframe?

tim_ops: pulled logs 1026-06-02T12:14:22Z: several 401s with introspection saying `missing_scope: embeddings`. Also a short probe burst ~80 reqs/min at 12:14:25Z triggering edge limiter -> 429s.

emma_cs: customer insists they call only chat. I'll ask them to run a HAR or grep. Suggested mitigation: disable aggressive retries, add jitter, and temporarily pause page analytics vendors.

ryan_eng: mitigation from our side: we can temporarily relax burst window for tenant `acct_blueridge` or whitelist their IP while they debug. That should prevent onboarding from stalling and reduce churn risk.

tim_ops: I can raise burst_window to 30s for that account for 24h. Need acct id and source IPs if they want a whitelist.

emma_cs: sent instructions. Customer replied that an A/B testing vendor fired an embeddings probe on page load. They disabled it and re-ran the flow. No more 401s or 429s.

olivia_se: follow-ups: 1) CS playbook: add note about vendor probes and required scopes 2) SDK team: highlight telemetry/probe behavior in release notes and ensure v1.3 warns on default probes 3) infra: consider clearer introspection errors mapping missing scope to helpful message.

edge-bot: Temporary policy change: burst_window increased to 30s for acct_blueridge by tim_ops at 2026-06-02T12:45:00Z (auto-revert in 24h).
